findings.current: “I am Hak Eui, a First-Generation Disciple of the Kunlun Sect. It’s an honor to meet you, Great Hero Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon.”
findings.defect: The repeated greeting adds a title and changes the wording of the line spoken at the end of Chapter 1080.
findings.rationale: The opening repeats the same moment, so the quoted speech should match Chapter 1080.
findings.replacement: “I am Hak Eui, a First-Generation Disciple of the Kunlun Sect. It is an honor to meet you, Great Hero Jin Taekyung.”

findings.current: Today, we’ll show them that we—the Yangtze River Channel League—are the Yangtze’s true rulers.
findings.defect: An unitalicized first-person thought interrupts third-person narration.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence is already marked as Mu Song’s direct thought; this sentence continues it.
findings.replacement: *Today, we’ll show them that we—the Yangtze River Channel League—are the Yangtze’s true rulers.*
findings.source: Chapter 1084, Mu Song’s thoughts as the ships advance

summary: Two actionable reading-copy inconsistencies: Hak Eui’s repeated greeting changes across the chapter boundary, and Mu Song’s first-person thought loses its thought formatting.
